import subprocess
from dataclasses import dataclass
import stripe
from agents import function_tool

@dataclass
class RoomBookingResult:
    room_id: str
    start_time: str
    amount_cents: int
    payment_intent_id: str
    booking_output: str

@function_tool
def book_paid_meeting_room(room_id: str, start_time: str, duration_minutes: int, customer_id: str, hourly_rate_cents: int) -> RoomBookingResult:
    amount = int(hourly_rate_cents * duration_minutes / 60)
    proc = subprocess.run(['roomctl', 'book', room_id, start_time, str(duration_minutes)], capture_output=True, text=True, check=True, timeout=60)
    # Look up the customer record to get the email for the receipt
    customer = stripe.Customer.retrieve(customer_id)
    receipt_email = customer.get('email')
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(amount=amount, currency='usd', customer=customer_id, confirm=True, off_session=True, receipt_email=receipt_email, metadata={'room_id': room_id, 'start_time': start_time})
    return RoomBookingResult(room_id, start_time, amount, intent.id, proc.stdout.strip())
